title: Flying craft through the mind for a brain neural interface
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: >> These UAP, UFO, other materials. They're not flown with joysticks. They're flown through the mind.

plain: Between 2008 and 2010, at a place called Baker Victory Services in western New York, a boy was used in work on a brain link for flying unidentified craft, because, he says, such craft are "not flown with joysticks. They're flown through the mind." That boy was Jordan Jose, who says a secret UFO program took him as a child, and he tells it from his own experience. If true, it would mean someone was training people to steer these craft by thought.
